title: 2026-10-30_Sofacy_Fysbis_Backdoor_Investigation_c85
description: Investigate and respond to a Sofacy group compromise using the Fysbis Linux backdoor.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target network has been compromised by the Sofacy group using the Fysbis Linux backdoor. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident. The Fysbis malware is a modular Linux backdoor that implements plug-in and controller modules as distinct classes. It can install itself with or without root privileges, increasing the options available to an adversary when selecting accounts for installation. The malware includes both 32-bit and 64-bit versions of ELF binaries.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have access to the `target` host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can SSH to `next-target` using the same credentials. Enter the passkey `start` to proceed.
levels.local_content: You have access to the `target` host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can SSH to `next-target` using the same credentials. Enter the passkey `start` to proceed.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service running on the `target` host that communicates with an external command-and-control (C2) server.
levels.solution: Check the running services and look for any that seem out of place or have unusual configurations. The hidden flag is the name of the suspicious service: systemkernelservicedefender.service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services that might be communicating with external servers.

levels.title: Determine C2 Port
levels.content: Determine which network port is used for the suspicious communication identified in the previous task.
levels.solution: Inspect the C2 service definitions and pay particular attention to `ExecStart`, which specifies the command launched by the service with a port number as an argument. The hidden flag is the C2 port number.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the service configuration for the suspicious service to find the port number.

levels.title: Identify Information Collection Service
levels.content: Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service running on the `target` host that runs at boot and every hour thereafter for information collection.
levels.solution: Check the running services and look for any that seem out of place or have unusual configurations. The hidden flag is the name of the suspicious service: local-inventory.timer.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services that might be collecting information at regular intervals.
